inputs.prompt:
Create ONE photorealistic 16:9 cinema frame. STRICT REFERENCE ROLES: IMAGE 1 is the approved cast and actual room; IMAGE 2 is the exact approved man identity crop. IMAGE 3 is ONLY the storyboard camera, framing, pose and outfit reference; NEVER copy that source actor's face or tattoos.
Match IMAGE 3 exactly: normal-lens three-quarter medium shot of man seated on olive sofa, dark walnut paneled wall behind, bright window edge RIGHT. Man positioned center-left, head around x=39%, y=26%, torso and bent knees visible. He grins with eyes nearly closed and lifts BOTH hands in clear thumbs-up gestures at chest/shoulder height, left thumb on image RIGHT and right thumb on image LEFT. Exactly two hands with natural fingers. No mug in either hand. Approved man from images 1 and 2, same face, messy black hair, plain navy polo and faded jeans, no patches or tattoos. Woman outside frame, no text.
Preserve the exact approved character identity, haircut and age. Keep the warm timber room's textures and colors consistent with IMAGE 1, viewed from the camera position in the storyboard reference. Match the reference shot's face size, headroom, foreground/background arrangement and lens perspective precisely. No title, subtitles, captions, writing, logos or watermark anywhere. No extra people, duplicated limbs, collage or split screen. This is a shot from the same movie, not a new cast or generic portrait.
